name: physicsos
description: PhysicsOS - verified physics visualization and Agent platform on DeepSeek Harness

scripts.build: pnpm run build:core && pnpm run build:web
scripts.build:web: pnpm -C vendor/deepseek-harness --filter @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-physicsos run bundle && pnpm -C vendor/deepseek-harness --filter @deepseek-ai/dsh-web-frontend run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:core && pnpm run typecheck:web
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:core && pnpm run lint:web
scripts.lint:web: pnpm -C vendor/deepseek-harness exec oxlint packages/client/ui-physicsos/src packages/client/ui-physicsos/tests
scripts.test: pnpm run test:core && pnpm run test:web
scripts.test:web: pnpm -C vendor/deepseek-harness exec vitest run packages/client/ui-physicsos/tests
